meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你规划、执行并记录分析方法的验证、确认和转移，例如计算线性、准确度、精密度、检测限等统计量，并生成符合ICH、USP等规范的报告。
howto.when: 当你提到“方法验证”、“验证方案”、“线性”、“准确度”、“精密度”、“检测限”等关键词，或询问某个分析方法是否适用于其预期目的时触发。

say.text: 请帮我规划一个HPLC含量测定方法的验证方案。
say.note: Claude 会要求指定框架并生成协议骨架。

say.text: 检查这个校准曲线的线性是否合格。
比较两个方法的等效性，使用Deming回归。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can help you plan, execute, and document the validation, verification, and transfer of analytical methods. It computes statistics like linearity, accuracy, precision, and detection limits, and generates reports compliant with ICH, USP, and other frameworks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords such as 'method validation', 'validation protocol', 'linearity', 'accuracy', 'precision', 'detection limit', or ask whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Plan a validation protocol for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the framework and generate a skeleton protocol.

say_en.text: Check the linearity of this calibration curve.
say_en.note: Claude runs lack-of-fit test and reports.

say_en.text: Compare two methods using Deming regression.
say_en.note: Claude runs compare_methods.py and outputs TOST results.
